findings: Roadmap target T-btz-trace-development: its printed conclusion 'graphDev g R is a Causal.Flat.SpacelikeDevelopment' cannot hold for R > 0, for any g (GX.E0TraceDev.not_spacelikeDevelopment_graphDev). The closed strip (0,R]xR includes the rim r = R, and IsSpacelikeLipschitzIn needs a full Lipschitz graph over an open set around every point of the image. Proof: l(q) = q0 - q1 reads r off the development, so l <= R on the image and l = R at the rim. In the local graph frame the kernel of l contains a null vector, so l increases strictly along some direction of the graph. The concurrent T-btz-c1-spacelike-development found the same fact independently (E0Surgery.spacelikeDevelopment_graphDev_iff).

Consequence for the strict library: GX.E0Surgery.lem_surface_complete_two_lip (GX/BTZ/SurfaceCompleteLip.lean:361) is vacuous, because its hypothesis hF is unsatisfiable for R > 0. The corrected form is the scaffold E0Surgery.lem_surface_complete_two_lipOn.

BTZ_1.tex l.1602 ('one can reduce the size of S'): the trace meets lem_surface_complete_two_lipOn only after a second shrinking R'' < R' of lem_blunt_spear's radius, with Omega = openStrip R'. Outside bspear v R the hypotheses do not describe Sig as the graph of tau_S, so nothing is known about Sig past the rim. The paper's own reduction step allows the shrinking.

kb_proposals: A SpacelikeDevelopment over a domain with boundary (such as the closed strip (0,R]xR) is impossible. Ask for it over an open set, e.g. graphDevOn g (openStrip R), and keep completeness on the closed strip (lem_surface_complete_two_lipOn).

FlatE0 N chart lemma: GX.E0TraceDev.flatE0_regChart. Near an off-axis point of a sector, chartAt N (psi x) composed with psi equals g • sectorChartY on an open neighbourhood. The pattern is flat_vertical_noLimit's connectedComponentIn plus exists_eqOn_sectorSmulInl.

The development btzPaperDev is globally injective on r > 0: r = q0 - q1 and theta = -q2 / r. So graphDev of any continuous g is an embedding (GX.E0TraceDev.isEmbedding_graphDev), and no sector bookkeeping is needed for the embedding field.
Restricting IsSpacelikeLipschitzIn to a smaller open set: GX.E0TraceDev.isSpacelikeLipschitzIn_inter. For the Isom invariance, pass fun g => Causal.Flat.isom_strongMorphism g as hG.
